contracts_dates_in_order.name: contracts_dates_in_order
contracts_dates_in_order.value: "contracts"."start_date" IS NULL OR "contracts"."end_date" IS NULL OR "contracts"."end_date" >= "contracts"."start_date"

instances_extra_attributes_format.name: instances_extra_attributes_format
instances_extra_attributes_format.value:
CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("instances"."extra_attributes") = 'object'
        THEN NOT jsonb_path_exists("instances"."extra_attributes", 'strict $.* ? (@.type() != "string")')
        ELSE false END

product_team_services_gh_orgs_format.name: product_team_services_gh_orgs_format
product_team_services_gh_orgs_format.value:
CASE WHEN "product_team_services"."gh_orgs"::text ~ '^[{]([A-Za-z0-9]+(-[A-Za-z0-9]+)*(,[A-Za-z0-9]+(-[A-Za-z0-9]+)*)*)?[}]$'
        THEN array_position("product_team_services"."gh_orgs", NULL) IS NULL
        ELSE false END

audit_log_values_match_action.name: audit_log_values_match_action
audit_log_values_match_action.value:
("audit_log"."action" = 'create' AND "audit_log"."before" IS NULL AND "audit_log"."after" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("audit_log"."action" = 'delete' AND "audit_log"."before" IS NOT NULL AND "audit_log"."after" IS NULL)
        OR ("audit_log"."action" IN ('update', 'publish', 'unpublish')
            AND "audit_log"."before" IS NOT NULL AND "audit_log"."after" IS NOT NULL)
